concepts.gloss_en: "Limping on his thigh" (Gen. 32) — the state of blemish of the legs (pegam ha-raglin) before rectification
Rectifying/mending the aspect of "limping on his thigh" — the act of tikkun of that blemished state, not the state itself

members.note: construct head is the act of tikkun; per rule 4 an action about X is not X

notes: Same Torah (lm1:75) and same verse imagery, but one form names the blemished state and the other names the act of rectifying it. Kept separate per rule 4 (action/state about X ≠ X).
